value.rationale: J(6,3) is the smallest balanced, self-complementary triple Johnson graph, and an explicit current paper newly computes total-domination numbers for J(n,3). The exact first-base-case optimizer orbit classification differentiates three natural intersection-pattern mechanisms and supplies a finite structural benchmark beyond the scalar value gamma_t=4. The precise orbit sizes and representatives are mathematically motivated and not implied by the minimum number. Its finite scope and lack of downstream theorem are disclosed.
